query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1
               FROM push_subscriptions ps
               LEFT JOIN user_sessions us ON us.id = ps.session_id
               WHERE ps.user_id = $1
                 AND ps.endpoint = $2
                 AND ps.revoked_at IS NULL
                 AND (ps.session_id IS NULL OR (us.revoked_at IS NULL AND us.expires_at > NOW()))
           ) AS "exists!"
